All checks pass. Summary of the actual results:

**Declaration build (`build-dts`)**
- `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --noCheck` — exit 0, no output
- `rollup -c rollup.dts.config.js` — exit 0, all 11 package `.d.ts` files created (including `packages/reactivity/dist/reactivity.d.ts` and `packages/vue/dist/vue.d.ts`)

**Consumer type tests (`test-dts-only`)**
- `tsc -p packages-private/dts-built-test/tsconfig.json` — exit 0, no errors (validates the built declarations)
- `tsc -p packages-private/dts-test/tsconfig.test.json` — exit 0, no errors (validates the source declarations, including the new `toValueOr` assertions in `packages-private/dts-test/ref.test-d.ts`)

No failures were reported, so no repairs were needed. The new `toValueOr` type assertions (value / ref / zero-arg getter inputs, `null`/`undefined` fallback, and falsy-value preservation for `0`, `false`, `''`) all type-check cleanly against both the source and the built declaration outputs.
